headline: Knee-to-chest onshore junk — one for the log if anything.
today: Small S windswell and onshore wind from the get-go, going cross-on SE in the afternoon. Nothing to write home about. Longboard the morning around the incoming tide if you're itching, otherwise sit tight.

daysToWatch.note: Swell builds to 5ft but wind is cross-on to onshore all day. Dawn is your only semi-clean window before the SSW onshore ruins it.
Best day of the stretch. Light NNE/ENE wind keeps it clean through morning on a waist-to-head-high swell — fish or shortboard early before the afternoon cross-on.
Prime angle on paper but it's only knee-high and buried under 20mph onshore wind. Skip.
